title: Make battery charge limit persistent after reboot
summary: Ensure that your custom battery charge limit remains active after restarting your Mac or resetting the SMC.
prerequisites: A charge limit should already be set using `sudo bclm write`.

steps.explain: Apply the current charge limit persistently so it survives reboots and SMC resets.

rollback.explain: Remove the persistent charge limit setting.

warnings: This modifies system-level power management persistence.
